messages.content: Find out about traffic laws in Texas.

function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location to perform the search in.

subject.description: The subject matter of the lawsuits.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits vary by road type (e.g., 55 mph on rural interstates, 45 mph on urban interstates).
• “No Speed Limit” zones exist on some rural highways; drivers must use caution. | Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) – *Speed Limits* page | | **Seat Belt & Child Restraint** | • All occupants must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster. | TxDOT – *Seat Belt and Child Restraint* | | **DUI / DWI** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) limit is 0.08% for adults.
• Zero tolerance for drivers under 21 (0.02% BAC).
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | Texas Alcoholic Beverage Commission (TABC) – *DUI/DWI* | | **Texting & Phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is prohibited.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | TxDOT – *Distracted Driving* | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • Stop at red lights and stop signs.
• Yield to pedestrians in crosswalks.
• In a roundabout, yield to traffic already inside. | TxDOT – *Right‑of‑Way Rules* | | **Lane Discipline** | • Keep to the right lane unless passing.
• Use turn signals 100 ft before turning. | TxDOT – *Lane Discipline* | | **School Bus Rules** | • Stop for a school bus with flashing red lights and extended stop sign.
• Cannot pass a stopped school bus. | TxDOT – *School Bus Safety* | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking within 20 ft of a fire hydrant.
• No parking on sidewalks or in crosswalks. | TxDOT – *Parking Rules* | | **Vehicle Inspection** | • Annual vehicle inspection required for most vehicles.
• Inspection includes brakes, lights, tires, and emissions. | Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV) – *Vehicle Inspection* | | **Insurance Requirements** | • Minimum liability coverage: $30,000 for bodily injury per person, $60,000 for total bodily injury, $25,000 for property damage. | TxDMV – *Insurance* | | **Special Situations** | • “No‑Stop” zones on some highways.
• “No‑Left Turn” signs.
• “No‑U‑Turn” signs. | TxDOT – *Special Traffic Signs* | ### How to Stay Updated 1. **TxDOT Website** – Offers the most current statutes, regulations, and public notices. 2. **TxDMV** – Handles licensing, registration, and insurance requirements. 3. **Texas Legislature Online** – Browse the Texas Transportation Code for the legal text. 4. **Local County Courts** – For specific local ordinances or recent changes. ### Quick Tips - **Always obey posted signs** – they reflect the most up‑to‑date rules for that area. - **Use hands‑free devices** if you need to talk or listen to music. - **Check your vehicle’s inspection status** before traveling long distances. - **Keep your insurance documents in the car** – you may need to show them during a traffic stop. --- **Need more detailed information?** - Visit the TxDOT website: https://www.txdot.gov/ - Check the TxDMV site: https://www.txdmv.gov/ - Look up the Texas Transportation Code online: https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/Docs/TS/htm/TS.0.htm Feel free to ask if you’d like specifics on any of the topics above!
